mapper.select: SELECT account.id, account.name, account.account_type, account.opening_balance + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ledger.transaction_type = '收入' THEN ledger.amount ELSE -ledger.amount END), 0) AS balance FROM mf_finance_account account LEFT JOIN mf_finance_transaction ledger ON ledger.account_id = account.id AND ledger.user_id = account.user_id WHERE account.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY account.id, account.name, account.account_type, account.opening_balance ORDER BY account.id
SELECT id FROM mf_finance_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mf_finance_account (user_id, name, account_type, opening_balance) VALUES (#{entity.userId}, #{entity.name}, #{entity.accountType}, #{entity.openingBalance})
mapper.update: UPDATE mf_finance_account SET name = #{entity.name}, account_type = #{entity.accountType}, opening_balance = #{entity.openingBalance}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{entity.userId} AND id = #{entity.id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM mf_finance_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM (SELECT updated_at FROM mf_finance_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT updated_at FROM mf_finance_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} UNION ALL SELECT updated_at FROM mf_finance_budget WHERE user_id = #{userId}) latest
